cohort: 150 pregnant women, 75 with diabetes and 75 without diabetes, at Khan Research Laboratory Hospital in Islamabad, Pakistan.
finding: Diabetic pregnancies had a higher rate of Caesarean section, neonatal resuscitation, NICU admission, and fetal macrosomia compared to non-diabetic pregnancies.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 3.58 kg in the diabetic group and 2.9 kg in the non-diabetic group; fetal macrosomia (weight >4kg) was more common in the diabetic group.
